newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Unisource declines comment on Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Unisource declines comment on Telefonica.

text.p: Dutch-headquartered business telecommunications provider Unisource on Friday declined to comment on a newspaper report that Telefonica of Spain was weighing up leaving Unisource.
Unisource is jointly owned by four European telephone companies, Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV, Telefonica, Telia of Sweden and Swiss Telecom.

Spanish newspaper El Pais reported on Friday that Italian state-controlled telecoms holding Stet was in talks to replace Telefonica in the Unisource group. "We have no comment on that," a Unisource spokeswoman said.

Speculation has built up recently that Telefonica was planning a partnership with MCI Communications Corp, breaking with the Unisource group which has a 60/40 pan-European business communications joint venture with AT&T Corp called AT&T-Unisource Communications Services.
